newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LAST MINUTE DEL PIERO PENALTY SAVES ITALY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAST MINUTE DEL PIERO PENALTY SAVES ITALY.

text.p: Alessandro Del Piero scored with a last-minute penalty to give Italy a 2-2 draw with France in the closing match of the Tournoi de France at the Parc des Princes on Wednesday.
With a French victory looking certain, Italy forced one last attack and Lilian Thuram upended Del Piero in the box. The Juventus striker made no mistake from the penalty spot.

Youri Djorkaeff appeared to have given France victory with an unstoppable 72nd-minute curling shot just nine minutes after coming on as a substitute in a match which started slowly but dramatically came to life in the last half-hour.
The result meant neither team won a match in the tournament, with both drawing twice and losing once, but France finished third behind England and Brazil because of a better goal difference.
Zinedine Zidane put France ahead after 12 minutes when he blasted home a powerful drive past Gianluca Pagliuca.

Neither side made another worthwhile impression in attack until the 61st minute when Pierluigi Casiraghi ruined Lionel Charbonnier's international debut in the French goal with a well-placed headed equaliser.
